messages:
jordan: Paging: automated SLO alerted — streaming p99 latency spike across eu-west-1. p95 ~220ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~350ms -> 12s. A bunch of live jobs showing tail stalls. Investigating now. :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Incident created: RED-2026-0456 (streaming-tail-latency). Severity: S1. Paging oncall @sasha. Links: https://grafana.redwood/streams?panel=tail_latency
sasha: saw the alert, looking. Any recent kernel/driver or TRT/FlashAttention rollouts in eu-west-1 in the last 2 hours?
jordan: yes — earlier today we rolled kernel build nv-kernel-2026-03-08 + TRT8 runtime v8.2.1 and flashed in flashattn-optim patch. Canary passed but traffic was low.
sasha: copying logs now. streaming decode queues are piling up and we see frequent pagefaults on the device and grpc stream stalls.
nana: fyi customer-ops flagged 3 enterprise tenants in eu region seeing >30s stalls on streaming sessions, one reported UX disconnects. @customer-ops can you confirm customers impacted?
customer-ops: confirmed — tenant acme-corp and beta partner syndeo both reported stalled sessions and reconnect loops. CS escalating.
kevin: I’m seeing a pattern: when decode hits KV cache miss + long attention window the kernel falls back to a slow path and causes paging. p99 aligned with a particular kernel symbol `run_flash_attn_forward` and increased allocations.
ellen: repro on a dev box with the same kernel/TRT combo — run into nvml pagefaults and then the process pauses ~6-8s multiple times. Looks like a memory management regression.
sasha: good catch. Can we toggle back to previous kernel quickly for eu-west-1? What’s the rollback command?
jordan: we have a hot rollback play: `redwood-deploy rollback --region eu-west-1 --component kernel --to nv-kernel-2026-02-22`
kevin: before rolling, quick mitigation: enable KV prefetch + reduce max_stream_window to shorten attention length for streaming. That reduces tail amplification. I can flip runtime config in the control plane.
sasha: do it. Changes to runtime config now: `streaming.max_window=1024 -> 512`, `runtime.kv_prefetch=true`.
(oncall-bot): deploy started: config update streaming.max_window -> 512 in eu-west-1 by sasha. Estimated 90s to rollout.
nana: any visible improvement on metrics?
sasha: after config change p95 back to ~300ms, p99 down to ~2.4s. Still above SLO but much better. Customers reporting fewer stalls.
ellen: that confirms config helped. We should still rollback kernel for safety until root cause fixed.
kevin: agree. I’ll prepare kernel rollback patch, but rollback will cause short pod restarts — schedule now?
jordan: prefer rolling immediately with canary 5% then ramp. Start canary on non-customer infra to validate.
nana: customer-ops, communicating planned rollback and expected blips?
customer-ops: will notify acme-corp/Syndeo immediately. ETA for rollback notice: 5m.
sasha: performing canary rollback now on staging-infra-eu with nv-kernel-2026-02-22.
(oncall-bot): canary rollback started by sasha on staging-infra-eu.
kevin: canary saw no pagefaults for 30m and streaming p99 stable ~180ms. Rolling to 25% prod nodes.
jordan: rolling to 25% -> 100% over next 12 minutes. Monitor dashboards.
(oncall-bot): kernel rollback rollout: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% complete. All pods restarted successfully.
sasha: after full rollback eu-west-1 p95 ~130ms, p99 ~210ms. Streaming stalls gone.
nana: incident impact update: two enterprise tenants had degraded sessions for ~14 minutes. No data loss reported. CS will follow up.
kevin: file for root cause: interaction between nv-kernel-2026-03-08 memory allocator change + TRT8 flashattn hot-path increased device page pressure under high attention lengths -> paging -> tail stalls. Likely regression in kernel VM mapping under concurrent CUDA kernels.
ellen: collecting kernel oops logs, nvml traces, and coredumps. Uploading to /artifacts/RED-2026-0456/
sasha: action items: (1) revert kernel (done), (2) push a patch to disable the allocator change or add fallback slowpath guard, (3) add e2e canary traffic test for long attention windows and KV miss patterns, (4) add alerting for pagefault-rate on GPUs.
jordan: assigning owners: kevin -> patch + RCA, ellen -> artifacts + diagnostics, sasha -> canary test + alerting, ana -> customer comms.
kevin: starting RCA. Early hypothesis note in ticket: "nv-kernel/allocator regression under high-concurrency decode causing device pagefaults when flashattn invoked".
(oncall-bot): Incident RED-2026-0456 transitioned to postmortem queue. Severity lowered to S2 after rollback and mitigations.
sasha: thanks everyone. If anything new crops up ping here. :thumbsup:
